methods.name: Classical brute force (ask all 1024 inputs)
methods.notes: Comparison only. Deterministic; each query is one Aer run of the oracle.

methods.name: Classical birthday search (random order)
methods.notes: Comparison only. Mean queries over 3000 runs; worst seen 122; success within 32 queries: 39%.

methods.name: Simon + GF(2) elimination (submitted)
methods.notes: Ideal: 100% with 40 runs; mean 10.7 runs to pin s. noisy_success = strict GF(2) solve at those cx error rates.

methods.name: Simon + majority vote
methods.notes: Noise-robust decoder, 200 runs per attempt; noisy_success = vote decoder at those cx error rates.

methods.name: Simon, output measured first
methods.notes: Equivalent to the submitted circuit; extra measurement of the output register.

methods.name: Grover search for s (f(x) = f(0), two marked states)
methods.notes: P(s)=0.50, P(0)=0.50; any non-zero outcome is s. 17 rounds, about sqrt(N) oracle calls: quadratic, not exponential.
